verdict.root_cause: At ~05:25 checkoutservice began failing intermittently while still up: PlaceOrder requests enter and stall before the payment and email stages, with no error lines and no downstream status code emitted [tr_36f27ffc828b], and its error ratio moved from an exactly-flat zero baseline to bursty failures averaging ~7% [tr_dc3a850e378d]. Nothing changed on checkoutservice itself [tr_f65e8090bef6], and productcatalogservice emitted zero errors with no change near onset [tr_bcbd00cddb24, tr_997255ac4ee2]. The only change in the onset window across every service inspected is an unreverted cartservice image-reference update to a hotfix build at 05:23:37, ~3 minutes before onset, unlike earlier image updates which all carried reverts [tr_08a3daab77f0]. Cartservice sits early in the order path, upstream of payment, which is where checkout's requests die; the running cartservice artifact is the most likely cause.
verdict.reasoning: Onset is pinned by a zero-variance baseline breaking at 05:25 [tr_dc3a850e378d], so the fault was newly introduced. The failure shape is a stall before the payment stage, not a fast failure or a crash [tr_36f27ffc828b], which points at an early dependency in the order path rather than checkout itself. Checkoutservice has no change to roll back [tr_f65e8090bef6] and productcatalogservice emitted zero errors throughout [tr_bcbd00cddb24], leaving the unreverted cartservice hotfix image at 05:23:37 as the only change temporally adjacent to onset [tr_08a3daab77f0]. Cartservice's own error metrics are unmeasurable (no samples in either window), so it is neither confirmed nor exonerated by metrics [tr_5e42d6b73fe2].
open_questions: No per-dependency or per-RPC breakdown was collected for checkoutservice, so the stalling callee is inferred, not observed [tr_dc3a850e378d].
Cartservice and shippingservice error-ratio series returned no samples at all, so neither is measured; empty is not healthy [tr_5e42d6b73fe2, tr_c7753157fef4].
No latency data was gathered for any service, and no cartservice logs were queried to confirm the new image is misbehaving.
Change history for payment, currency, email, ad and recommendation was never inspected [tr_f65e8090bef6].

alternatives.root_cause: An uninspected checkout dependency (payment, currency, email) became slow, and checkoutservice hangs waiting on it.
alternatives.why_not: Consistent with the stall signature, but no change record or metric was gathered for those services, and the log evidence shows the request dying before the payment stage is reached [tr_36f27ffc828b].

alternatives.root_cause: The new cartservice hotfix image carries a wrong runtime setting rather than a broken build, and that value breaks the cart call path.
alternatives.why_not: The recorded change is an image reference, not a config value; the recurring REDIS_ADDR override was reverted ~6.8h before onset and was not in effect [tr_08a3daab77f0].

proposal.if_wrong: If ten minutes after the recreate checkoutservice error ratio is still bursty and PlaceOrder lines still have no following stage line, the stall is not in the cart call and the hotfix is exonerated. proposal.blast_radius: One service recreated; frontend and checkoutservice see cart RPC connection resets for the recreate duration, and loadgenerator sessions on those paths register errors. Cart contents live in redis-cart, so persisted state should survive.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical severity with simultaneous checkout, frontend, and loadgenerator alerts indicates a user-facing failure across the request path, not a single quiet warning.
